SOP-09 Rev 2 — Tank Shell Evaluation Procedure
SUPERSEDED BY REV 3
Superseded procedure. Retained for reference only.
Minimum thickness: t_min = 4.9 x D x (H - 0.3) x G / (S x E)
Thresholds: retirement = t_min; alert = t_min + 2.0 mm.
Corrosion rate = (previous - current) / years between surveys.
Remaining life = (current - t_min) / corrosion rate.
Next inspection interval = lesser of (RL / 2) and 10 years.
